Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL 4-TB server storage

Body.Content:
Customers who use Azure Database for PostgreSQL can now create 4-TB servers or update existing PostgreSQL server storage to 4 TB when using the General Purpose or Memory Optimized pricing tier.

With this increase in server storage, the service now supports even larger workloads and provides customers with the peace of mind of knowing that they can easily accommodate future growth.
